rule: The 30x30 input is a crop of a 32x32 mosaic that is mirror symmetric about x <-> 31-x and y <-> 31-y. One rectangle is painted colour 7, and no other cell is 7. The output is the hidden mosaic content under that rectangle, at the rectangle's size. Each hidden cell equals its in-grid, unmasked mirror partners.
scope: Construct an N-wide crop of an (N+2)-wide doubly reflected mosaic, mask a rectangle with colour7 and return the latent hidden patch. Restore even sides12..30 with weighted sampling of larger grids, variable motif block size/offset and conditional mask-size sampling. Verify outputs using visible reflection orbits, preserving the weak transpose fallback required by the first canonical example.

authored_scope: Supported: the fixed 30x30 grid with axis 31; random 16x16 quadrants built from motif blocks of size 2-6 (default 3-5) on an offset lattice; 2-6+ colour palettes without 7; an optional weak transpose cue; random recoverable masks with sides 2..10 (up to 14 on request) at any position, including masks that straddle the central axes or touch the border rows and columns; and explicit-latent fixture replay. Deliberately not supported: other grid sizes, because the task geometry and the verified transform fix axis 31; random scenes whose mask cells can be resolved only by the transpose cue (only the train-1 fixture replay has these); and 1x1 or single-orbit random masks.
authored_constraints: Colour 7 appears only on the mask rectangle; palettes and quadrants never contain 7.
For random scenes, every masked cell has an in-grid, unmasked partner among (y,31-x), (31-y,x) and (31-y,31-x).
For random scenes, the hidden patch contains at least two colours. Explicit masks lying in a single mirror orbit are rejected up front.
The quadrant is never exactly transpose symmetric, so the diagonal cue stays weak.
All retry loops are bounded. A failure raises ValueError rather than returning a degenerate scene.
Explicit controls are type-checked: bools and floats are rejected, as are conflicting combinations.
